definitions.explanation: Acting without proper consideration or planning; carelessly.
To an excessive or disproportionate degree.

examples.japanese: {無闇|むやみ}に{信|しん}じてはいけない。
{無闘|むやみ}に{触|さわ}らないでください。
{無闇|むやみ}に{約束|やくそく}してはいけない。

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{無|む} (without) + {闇|やみ} (darkness) → acting blindly, without seeing

VARIATIONS:
- {無闇|むやみ}: attributive form
- {無闘|むやみ}やたらに: emphatically reckless

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無闇|むやみ}に{手|て}を{出|だ}す: to meddle carelessly
- {無闘|むやみ}に{信|しん}じる: to believe blindly
- {無闇|むやみ}に{動|うご}く: to move around recklessly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- やたらに: randomly, excessively
- {軽率|けいそつ}に: rashly, thoughtlessly
- みだりに: indiscriminately
